listing.name: Star Citizen Ships Pack
listing.summary: Adds a variety of Star Citizen-inspired ships, including fighters, gunboats, carriers, and capital ships, with balanced stats and visual designs.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a variety of Star Citizen-inspired ships, including fighters, gunboats, carriers, and capital ships, with balanced stats and visual designs.

description:
Why did I make this mod?

I have been a long-time backer and fan of the MMO Star Citizen and wanted to see the amazingly designed ships in massive fleet engagements.

How balanced is it?

I have tried my best to balance it around vanilla ships and fighters, but of course, there will be elements that I fail to account for. Please let me know what I can change in case anything is too overpowered or underpowered!

Lore:

Ships from Domain Era that independent explorers would rediscover and integrate into their fleet whenever possible. Due to the blueprints being lost through time, these ships are quite rare and are seldom sold by independent sellers.

Download link:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1af72eMmwIgQrT2zgBLzt2LzhopEb2Fyq/view?usp=sharing

What the mod adds!

The names may not perfectly match the variants depicted as they appear in Star Citizen due to my reluctance to use dark colored sprites in the darkness of space.

Fighters

SpoilerGladius

A fast, light fighter with dogfighting capabilities and comes equipped with a emp nose turret to cripple and overwhelm defenses

F7A MkII

F7A MkII Hornets are the baseline medium fighters for carrier operations that operate as the jack of all trades that excels at  fighter and missile interception

F8C

The F8A Lightning space superiority heavy fighter can dominate any other fighters in a dogfight and can even dish out significant damage to larger ships if left unchecked

Ares Ion

The Ares Star Fighter Ion is an anti-capital fighter with its built-in cannon, but must be escorted by other fighters to fulfill its devastating purpose

A1 Spirit

The A1 Spirit is a medium-sized light bomber that can perform quick hit and run strikes while avoiding direct fire from larger opponents (I used the C1 sprite since the A1 sprite is literally just a black Dorito)

Constellation

The Constellation is a multi-person freighter that is often used as a light gunship due to its immense firepower and a respectable amount of anti-fighter missiles (used phoenix sprite due to  better visual clarity)

Redeemer

The redeemer is a powerful combat gunship outfitted to gun down any fighters and missiles in its proximity while being able to tank fire from larger ships with fortress shields

Retaliator

The Retaliator is a large torpedo boat that can deploy devastating anti-capital warheads while also being capable of protecting itself against smaller foes.

[close]

Ships

SpoilerHammerhead

The Hammerhead is the ultimate fighter screen that can secure entire sections of a battlefield from anything smaller than them

Perseus

The Perseus gunboat packs a serious punch for such a small ship at incredible speeds, but lacks the hull health to take direct fights against larger ships.

Polaris

The Polaris functions as a nimble torpedo destroyer capable of unloading capital-grade payload while being under-gunned for direct head-to-head engagements. It also comes with a small hanger for protection

Kraken

The Kraken is a light carrier capable of carrying a sizable fleet of fighters while having the minimum firepower to defend itself in direct firefights

Idris

The Idris is an artillery ship that has a large interchangeable spinal mount and enough turrets for it to defend itself in any engagement. It also comes with carrier capabilities to function as a light carrier while it rains heavy artillery fire from afar.

Javelin

The Javelin is a line battleship armed with two heavy torpedo bays at the nose and is heavily gunned in all directions, especially towards the front. It also comes with two hangar bays to deploy escort gunships and fighters to further protect itself

Bengal carrier

The Bengal fleet carrier is a behemoth of a ship capable of unleashing a deadly barrage of fire, missiles and fighters against anything that enters its sights. The ship itself is incredibly rare and expensive to deploy, but its capabilities are a sight to behold

[close]

Video Showcase of ships in action:

How to get them

They will spawn rarely in independent and mercenary fleets. They can be bought at a high cost in independent-owned markets. They can also be found throughout the world.

Installation:

1. Just toss the unpacked file into the mods folder

2. Enjoy!

compatibility/dependencies:

-This mod mostly uses vanilla weapons, so there shouldn’t be any dependencies

-Since this mod only adds ships, it should be safe to add mid-save and likely won't conflict with anything

Future plans:

May add weapons next and possibly more ships. Please feel free to suggest what you’d like added.

Disclaimer:

I do not seek to profit in any way from the mod and take no ownership of the assets. I have modified them a bit to match the in-game sprites, but I understand it can still look a bit out of place.
